title: IDOR on note endpoints
root_cause: Note queries do not check owner_id, so any authenticated user can read, edit, or delete any note by changing the ID.
fix: Add 'and owner_id = ?' to every note query; return 404 so note IDs can't be enumerated.

title: Broken Function Level Authorization
root_cause: API allows users to view all registered users without proper authorization checks. A normal user can visit the admin endpoint that allows an admin to view all registered users.
fix: Require the admin role on admin endpoints with @require_auth(role='admin'), returning 403 and logging the attempt.

title: Broken Authentication on logout
root_cause: Logout does not invalidate the token, allowing reuse after logout. If a token is stolen, a logout should invalidate that session but doesn't so tokens are able to be reused.
fix: Invalidate the token on logout by deleting it from the database.

title: Excessive data exposure
owasp_category: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
root_cause: The endpoint returns every column of each user row instead of an explicit set of fields, so password hashes are included in the response. If combined with flaw 2, a normal user could exploit this to gain access to sensitive information.
fix: Return specific fields (username, id, role, created_at) instead of the whole row.
